document.about: PLoS ONE 2016, 11(1): e0146796, 'Core Proteomic Analysis of Unique Metabolic Pathways of Salmonella enterica for the Identification of Potential Drug Targets', PMC4723313. Its Table 2 (p6) lists 42 strains in shaded rows. Two names wrap onto a second line that starts afresh (`Gallinarum Pullorum` over `CDC1983 67`), set closer under the name than the rows are apart. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#371): the wrapped line ended the table, and rows 11 on were a second table with no header. A line holding one cell, between two rows of figures and within the extent of the cell above it, carries on that cell where it sits a quarter or more tighter under it than the next row's cell sits under it.

checks.issue: #371: rows 11 on were a second table with no column names.
